'''Clan Nial''' were a [[Clan|family]] of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] with a tradition of influential [[Politics/Legends|political]] work. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] the family was extensive and had roots in numerous locations including [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. There the family set up their eldest daughter at the time, [[Jovel Nial]], as a [[Senatorial aide]] to the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Trellev Aquem]] of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. [[Korsin Fenn]], owner of the [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] pallor known as the [[Spyder]], was a Nial clansman and as such sometimes provided Jovel Nial with information from his customers.<ref name="UABS" />
